display.title: Episode 312: A Diamond From Heaven
display.summary_short: A pre-1A class celebrates finishing the parshiyos of Sefer Bereishis, and Rashi's father gives up a priceless diamond rather than let it adorn an idol.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi reminds listeners that the tzedakah-box drawing contest closes on Yud Shevat, and that every entry wins a Moshiach Times magazine. Before the Hakochainik march he teaches that a smile is catching and that Hashem loves to see His children happy. Next, he visits a pre-1A class at Beis Yaakov of Boro Park whose teacher taught them a song with the names of all the parshiyos of Sefer Bereishis; the children sing it, say 'Chazak chazak v'nischazek' and recite the Shema, and Uncle Yossi explains how precious holy words are when little children say them. Story time: Rabbi Yitzchak, a Torah scholar and diamond dealer in France, buys a rare diamond, then learns the governor wants it for an idol. After pouring out his heart in Tehillim, he takes the stone to the governor's seaside porch and lets it fall into the sea, sacrificing his fortune for Kiddush Hashem. A heavenly voice promises him a son who will light up the world with Torah: Rashi.
display.lesson: Honoring Hashem is worth more than any fortune; teach children holy words from the youngest age.
